contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #019: The local p-adic section conjecture and global consequences.

Let k be a finite extension of Q_p, Omega the completion of its algebraic closure, and ell an odd prime different from p. Audit the entire-inverse-image collar-root lemma for smooth proper connected curves of genus at least two.

definitions.Omega: algebraically closed complete rank-one field with v(Omega*)=Q, v=-log_p(abs)
definitions.entire inverse image: every analytic point over the collar, including points outside the skeleton
definitions.permitted disks: pairwise disjoint sufficiently small coordinate disks about distinct algebraic points, with coordinates vanishing simply there

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 019 (The local p-adic section conjecture and global consequences.; papers: Étale covers with a prescribed exterior sheet; The p-adic section conjecture; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

For every permitted curve and finite family of coordinate disks, there exist a connected finite etale cover and concentric open subcollars with endpoints in abs(Omega*) on whose entire inverse images every coordinate has an analytic ell-th root.

Given a finite curve cover extending from a stable source model to a semistable target model, every target node annulus contains a rational-endpoint concentric subcollar whose entire inverse image lies in the finite union of source node tubes mapping to that target node.

For every finite family of node annuli of a stable curve of genus at least two, a connected finite etale cover admits an analytic ell-th root of each node coordinate on the entire inverse image of that annulus.
A unit on an open disk has constant norm in abs(Omega*). A unit on an open annulus is c*S^d*(1+h), with c nonzero, d integral and abs(h)<1 pointwise; it has an ell-th root exactly when ell divides d.

Over an algebraically closed field of characteristic p different from ell, every smooth proper connected residue curve with two distinct marks P,Q has a connected degree-ell cyclic cover totally ramified at P,Q and unramified elsewhere; every positive-genus residue curve has a connected degree-ell cyclic etale cover.

For every compact topological space X, open N, and continuous real function v whose values outside N are rational, every irrational a strictly inside a real window has rational lower and upper bounds inside that window with the whole inverse open interval contained in N. The universal circuit Riemann-Hurwitz and stability identities hold, and a positive-size genus-zero stable tree side cannot have total valence 2*N-1.

For every permitted curve and finite family of coordinate disks, there exist a connected finite etale cover and concentric open subcollars with endpoints in abs(Omega*) on whose entire inverse images every coordinate has an analytic ell-th root.

external_assumptions.statement: Every hyperbolic curve over a p-adic local field satisfies Sigma-RNS for Sigma all primes, and after finite ground extension every compactified normal model is dominated by the compactified stable model of a connected geometrically pro-Sigma finite etale Galois cover.

external_assumptions.statement: A tame covering of metrized complexes over the skeleton of a fixed triangulated punctured curve lifts to a tame covering of triangulated punctured curves, allowing loops. Its skeleton and vertex set are the full inverse images, and all algebraic branch points lie among the prescribed punctures; with no punctures the lift is finite etale.
external_assumptions.source: Amini, Baker, Brugalle and Rabinoff, Lifting harmonic morphisms I; primary arXiv v3 PDF stored in research/collar_root_audit/sources/abbr_v3.pdf.

external_assumptions.statement: Multiplication by n on an abelian variety of dimension g is a surjective isogeny of degree n^(2g), etale when the characteristic does not divide n; over an algebraically closed field its prime-to-characteristic n-torsion is (Z/nZ)^(2g). Applied to the Jacobian this supplies divisor-class divisibility and nonzero ell-torsion when g is positive.
external_assumptions.source: J. S. Milne, Abelian Varieties, author version January 2, 2022; exact primary PDF stored in research/collar_root_audit/sources/milne_av.pdf.

external_assumptions.statement: On a strict closed annulus a unit factors as a nonzero constant times an integral coordinate power times (1+g), with sup abs(g)<1. The proof on nested annuli and the disk-unit norm fact give the open-domain statements; the latter are justified separately in the report rather than attributed to Proposition 2.2 alone.

external_assumptions.statement: A semistable model gives finitely many type-2 vertices over component generic points, open disk tubes over smooth closed points, and finitely many open node annuli. Reduction is functorial under model morphisms. Proper analytifications and closed annular windows are compact. Type-2 completed residue fields have the ground value group.
external_assumptions.source: ABBR primary arXiv v3, Sections 3.2-3.13 and 5.3-5.17, together with the standard properness and classification properties of Berkovich curves; the exact analytic facts used are isolated in the report.

claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open Set

namespace CollarRootAudit

theorem rational_collar_capture
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X]
    (N : Set X) (hN : IsOpen N) (v : X → ℝ) (hv : Continuous v)
    (hbad : ∀ x, x ∉ N → ∃ q : ℚ, v x = (q : ℝ))
    {a lower upper : ℝ} (ha : Irrational a)
    (hlower : lower < a) (hupper : a < upper) :
    ∃ r R : ℚ,
      lower < (r : ℝ) ∧ (r : ℝ) < a ∧
      a < (R : ℝ) ∧ (R : ℝ) < upper ∧
      ∀ x, (r : ℝ) < v x → v x < (R : ℝ) → x ∈ N := by
  let F : Set ℝ := v '' Nᶜ
  have hF : IsClosed F := (hN.isClosed_compl.isCompact.image hv).isClosed
  have haF : a ∉ F := by
    rintro ⟨x, hx, hxa⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hbad x hx
    exact ha ⟨q, hq.symm.trans hxa⟩
  have hopen : IsOpen (Fᶜ ∩ Ioo lower upper) :=
    hF.isOpen_compl.inter isOpen_Ioo
  have hmem : a ∈ Fᶜ ∩ Ioo lower upper := ⟨haF, hlower, hupper⟩
  obtain ⟨l, u, hlu, hI⟩ :=
    mem_nhds_iff_exists_Ioo_subset.mp (hopen.mem_nhds hmem)
  obtain ⟨r, hlr, hra⟩ := exists_rat_btwn hlu.1
  obtain ⟨R, haR, hRu⟩ := exists_rat_btwn hlu.2
  have hrmem : (r : ℝ) ∈ Fᶜ ∩ Ioo lower upper :=
    hI ⟨hlr, lt_trans hra hlu.2⟩
  have hRmem : (R : ℝ) ∈ Fᶜ ∩ Ioo lower upper :=
    hI ⟨lt_trans hlu.1 haR, hRu⟩
  refine ⟨r, R, hrmem.2.1, hra, haR, hRmem.2.2, ?_⟩
  intro x hxL hxU
  by_contra hx
  have hxF : v x ∈ F := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact (hI ⟨lt_trans hlr hxL, lt_trans hxU hRu⟩).1 hxF

theorem circuit_genus_balance (n g : ℤ) :
    2 * (n * g) - 2 = n * (2 * g - 2) + 2 * (n - 1) := by
  ring

theorem circuit_stability_balance (n g val : ℤ) :
    2 * (n * g) - 2 + (2 + n * (val - 2)) =
      n * (2 * g - 2 + val) := by
  ring

theorem unramified_stability_balance (d g gp val valp : ℤ)
    (hgenus : 2 * gp - 2 = d * (2 * g - 2))
    (hval : valp = d * val) :
    2 * gp - 2 + valp = d * (2 * g - 2 + val) := by
  rw [hgenus, hval]
  ring

theorem stable_tree_side_impossible (N total : ℕ)
    (hpositive : 0 < N) (htree : total + 1 = 2 * N)
    (hstable : 3 * N ≤ total) : False := by
  omega

end CollarRootAudit
